source_snapshot.items: All SSD NVMe LED Check - Locate
source_snapshot.procedure: Insert an NVMe SSD, select it through the NVMe adapter, invoke Locate and check the physical Locate LED; collect photos and logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Check the LED function defined by the system specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL proposes controller/BMC locate control plus operator observation, but includes insecure SSH and undocumented raw IPMI without exact adapter/drive selection or clear-state verification.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly identifies hybrid control and observation but leaves the command, mapping and affected indicator unsafe and ambiguous.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds stable SSD-slot-adapter identity, non-target observation, supported clear behavior and recovery boundaries.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Present and Access/Busy rows test different LED trigger paths; this row owns explicit Locate/UID selection and deassertion.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Each target must be selected by stable controller identity and followed through asserted, non-target and cleared states.

original_test_intent: Verify that the approved NVMe RAID/controller Locate operation activates the specified Locate/UID LED on the exact selected SSD and no other drive, then clears it normally.
original_method: A qualified operator inserts and visually identifies each mapped SSD while the agent issues only the documented exact-adapter/exact-drive locate and clear commands, preserving physical photos and complete controller/storage state.
manual_activity: User approves the mapped command and recovery path; qualified operator identifies and photographs target and neighboring LEDs during assert and clear; agent controls only the documented exact target.
required_inputs: Stable SSD serial/NVMe ID to slot/backplane/adapter/controller mapping
Locate/UID LED color, cadence, timeout and non-target expectation
Vendor tool/version and documented per-drive assert/clear syntax
Supported insertion, data/RAID and service procedure
Qualified operator, independent access and stuck-indicator recovery
safety_requirements: Resolve the controller and drive selector to a stable physical slot before any command
Confirm Locate is indicator-only and does not alter RAID membership, power or data state
Capture baseline and preserve existing logs rather than clearing them
Stop on wrong or multiple LEDs, ambiguous mapping, storage/RAID/thermal/SEL error or failed clear
Do not improvise raw IPMI bytes or issue an unscoped locate-all operation
agent_execution_scope: Collect stable drive-slot-controller and health baseline
Issue the approved single-target Locate assert and clear commands once per mapped SSD
Record command output, timestamps and final cleared state while operator captures physical evidence
Do not handle hardware, claim remote visual confirmation, retry a failed clear, rebuild storage or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the controller mapping, tool syntax, LED matrix, timeout and recovery
Provide a qualified operator and own any failed-clear or wrong-target recovery
Review target/non-target/clear evidence and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Controller locate may be applicable, but the generic raw IPMI example lacks platform semantics and exact target selection; lsblk alone cannot prove the illuminated physical bay.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor-documented per-controller, per-drive Locate/UID assert and clear interface with stable serial/slot mapping, complete return codes and synchronized operator photos of target and non-target LEDs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVMe insertion, adapter selection, Locate LED check and the source 15/8 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Exercise each mapped SSD through baseline, single-target assert and verified clear while observing neighboring bays and storage health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes target selection and deassertion auditable and prevents a generic management command from being accepted as physical proof.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Automation drives the approved controller state; a human still verifies physical target exclusivity and visible behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Logical drive numbering and physical slots can diverge after replacement or reboot, so stable identifiers and a freshly verified map are mandatory.

project_override_considerations: If Locate is exposed through NVMe-MI, SES, a RAID CLI or BMC Redfish rather than IPMI, use only the project-approved interface and preserve its exact component identity; interfaces are not interchangeable by assumption.
expected_evidence: Stable identity and baseline LED/storage state
Exact assert and clear commands, outputs, exit codes and timestamps
Operator/date photos of selected and adjacent bays before, during and after Locate
Final cleared/restored state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: All sources identify a hybrid Locate/UID LED test; GPT V2 constrains the unsafe generic command and adds the missing target/clear evidence without changing scope.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The documented tool, mapping and operator are identifiable prerequisites; the test semantics and static review remain clear.

review_improvement: Turns an ambiguous indicator toggle into an exact-target, exclusive-illumination and verified-clear test tied to stable physical storage identity.
independent_technical_reasoning: Locate testing is about the correctness of the logical-to-physical mapping as much as the LED itself. A successful controller response can still illuminate the wrong bay, and an asserted light left uncleared is a residual fault, so acceptance must combine exact selectors, observation of target and non-target bays, and explicit deassertion evidence.
